# Sophia AI Video Factory

> Multi-tenant SaaS for AI-driven video creation, affiliate marketing automation, and multi-channel publishing. Built on Cloudflare Workers, paid in USDT.

## What Sophia Does

- AI video generation (HeyGen avatars + ElevenLabs voice + Remotion render)
- Affiliate offer discovery (9 networks: Impact, PartnerStack, Binance, Bybit, Bitget, Coinbase, CJ, ShareASale, ClickBank)
- Multi-channel publishing (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Zalo)
- USDT crypto payouts (NOWPayments) — global creators bypassing Western banking
- Quality scoring + geo compliance (US/UK/SG/CN crypto block default)
- Webhooks for event-driven integrations
- Per-tenant customization (branding, scoring weights, cron cadence, channel templates, MCP servers)

## Documentation

- Pricing: https://sophia.agencyos.network/pricing
- Guide: https://sophia.agencyos.network/guide
- API endpoint: POST https://sophia.agencyos.network/api/v1/missions
- Status: https://sophia.agencyos.network/status

## Architecture

- Stack: Next.js 16 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind 4
- Runtime: Cloudflare Workers (OpenNext)
- Database: Cloudflare D1
- Storage: Cloudflare R2
- Payment: NOWPayments (USDT) primary, PayOS (VN) backup

## Optional

For deeper integration, see /api/v1/factory/url-to-revenue (paste any affiliate URL → AI generates localized video variants → publishes → tracks conversions).
